full_validation_artifacts.commit_policy: ignored run storage; hashes and compact summary are committed

divided_highways.note: 624 station(s) sit on a divided highway and were compared against both carriageways summed using the direction recorded in the run's link geometry.

metrics.by_road_class_note: Accuracy is not the same on every kind of road. On primary the median error is 21.56% across 84 stations; on trunk it is 333.76% across 283. A figure for a trunk road is far weaker evidence than the same figure for a primary, and the study-area median hides that.
metrics.geh_basis: GEH computed on average-hourly equivalents (daily volume / 24); peak-hour GEH, the customary basis for the <5 acceptance rule, will differ.

model_caveats: tract fragments are not calibrated TAZs
jobs are estimated from tract-scale demographic proxies

external gateways are inferred from major boundary-crossing roads, and the traffic entering at each one is a flat daily figure by road class -- not an observed count, and the same figure everywhere in the country

reasons: Median absolute percent error is 101.77%, above the 30.00% screening threshold.
At least one core facility has 4152.21% absolute percent error, above the 50.00% critical-facility threshold.

shared_model_links.note: A model link holds one volume, so several stations matched to it are several observations of one number. Where they agree they are compared once at their median; where they disagree the pairing is ambiguous and none of them grades the link. The cause is network resolution — a link long enough to span a junction genuinely carries different volumes at its ends.

zone_resolution.note: Share of internal trips that begin and end in the same zone, so they carry VMT but never appear on any link. OpenPlan bands this share when it records a claim for this run: past its threshold the gate above is NOT recorded as a screening claim, because a link-level comparison cannot establish one at that resolution. The banding is OpenPlan's own screening heuristic, not an adopted standard. Null means the run's producer did not record the share.
